description: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (public JSON). With cveId: whether that CVE is on the list, with vendor, product, date added, federal due date, required action and ransomware-use flag. Without it: catalog size, release date and the newest additions (up to 50). Listing means exploitation was reported, not a risk score. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many newest additions to list when no cveId is given, 1 to 50 (default 10)

name: security_cisa_known_exploits
title: Security Cisa Known Exploits
